If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Associate Director, Software Engineering.

Business: IWPB Technology

Principal Responsibilities

  • Manage complicated, cross-platform production issues involving Operating Systems, Networking and Databases, including services hosted on external platforms.
  • Operate and continuously improve monitoring and alerting, and support incident response and service restoration.
  • Support and improve CI/CD pipelines and release processes, embedding DevSecOps principles into operational workflows.
  • Agree and develop SLOs/SLIs across engineering teams and with Product Owners, and use them to drive reliability improvements.
  • Engage in new features and builds at inception to ensure operability, stability, and delivery quality before go-live.
  • Build and maintain application & infrastructure performance tooling, and take steps to improve overall production stability.
  • Develop and enhance the existing observability tooling stack (logs/metrics/traces) to improve detection and diagnosis.
  • Contribute to the wider bank community to share technology, run trials on new tools, and scale successful practices.

Requirements

  • Experience in IT Operations / Production Support / Reliability Engineering
  • Solid track record delivering agile projects at scale, ideally in FinTechs or Investment Banks (IBs).
  • Ability to drive operational improvements and influence change in a complex technical environment.
  • Experience building and configuring monitoring/alerting, e.g. AppDynamics, Geneos, Datadog, Splunk, AWS CloudWatch.
  • Software engineering experience (the original template stated 2+ years) in one or more of: Python, Java, C/C++, Ruby, JavaScript, with a focus on automation/tooling.
  • Experience developing or operating enterprise technology in the cloud: AWS, GCP, Azure, ACS.
  • Knowledge on tools and software including Grafana, Docker, OpenAI, Jenkins, Ansible, Puppet, Google Stack Driver
  • Fluent in Mandarin and English.

You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.

HSBC is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and, opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. We encourage applications from all suitably qualified persons irrespective of, but not limited to, their gender or genetic information, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, social status, medical care leave requirements, political affiliation, people with disabilities, color, national origin, veteran status, etc., We consider all applications based on merit and suitability to the role.

Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

The Opportunity

The Principal Engineer in Asia & Middle East Tech (AMET) is a senior technical leader who uplifts engineering capability, efficiency and productivity across multiple teams. You’ll set technical direction, accelerate adoption of modern engineering practices and tooling, and drive responsible integration of AI into the development environment and, where appropriate, production systems—balancing innovation with governance, model risk, explainability and data privacy. You’ll work across boundaries with product, security, risk and operations to deliver resilient outcomes in a regulated environment.

Key responsibilities

  • Drive AI adoption at scale
  • Define and execute an AI adoption roadmap across the engineering organisation (e.g., coding assistance, test generation, incident support, documentation, knowledge search, SDLC automation).
  • Identify high-value use cases, prioritise them with measurable outcomes, and take them from prototype to production.
  • Establish repeatable patterns (playbooks, templates, golden paths) so teams can adopt AI consistently.
  • Technical leadership
  • Design reference patterns for AI-enabled engineering workflows (e.g., RAG for internal knowledge, secure prompt patterns, evaluation harnesses, model routing, guardrails).
  • Lead technical decisions on build vs buy, model selection, integration patterns, and platform capabilities.
  • Ensure solutions align with enterprise architecture, cloud strategy, and engineering standards.
  • Responsible AI, security, and risk-by-design
  • Embed controls for data handling, privacy, IP protection, and secure SDLC when using AI tools.
  • Partner with Cyber Security, Risk, Compliance, and Legal to ensure safe usage patterns and approvals.
  • Define governance for prompts, datasets, model outputs, and human-in-the-loop review where required.
  • Engineering excellence & transformation outcomes
  • Improve engineering productivity and quality through AI-enabled automation (CI/CD, code review, testing, release, observability).
  • Define and track metrics (e.g., lead time, change failure rate, MTTR, test coverage, defect escape rate, developer satisfaction).
  • Champion modern engineering practices (platform engineering, DevSecOps, SRE, trunk-based development) and show how AI amplifies them.
  • Enablement, coaching, and community building
  • Coach engineers and tech leads on effective AI usage (prompting, evaluation, safe patterns, limitations).
  • Run workshops, office hours, and internal communities of practice; create learning paths and onboarding materials.
  • Mentor senior engineers and help raise the technical bar across teams.
  • Stakeholder management & influence
  • Work closely with Heads of Engineering, Product Owners, Architecture, and Operations to align priorities and remove blockers.
  • Communicate clearly to technical and non-technical audiences; influence without authority across multiple teams and regions.
  • Provide pragmatic guidance—balancing pace with safety, quality, and long-term maintainability.

Required Experience & Skills

  • Degree in Computer Science/Engineering or related discipline; MSc/PhD preferred.
  • 10+ years’ software engineering experience, ideally in financial services or other regulated environments.
  • Proven track record improving engineering capability and delivery outcomes through modern engineering practices, standards and developer tooling.
  • Practical experience applying AI/ML or GenAI in engineering contexts (e.g., copilots, RAG, code intelligence, test generation, incident triage).
  • Experience designing secure, scalable platforms and APIs; familiarity with cloud-native patterns and CI/CD.
  • Strong understanding of SDLC, DevSecOps, and production operations (observability, incident management, SRE practices).
  • Excellent communication and coaching skills; able to lead through influence.

Preferred / Nice-to-have

  • Experience building internal developer platforms or “golden paths”.
  • Familiarity with model evaluation, prompt engineering patterns, and guardrail techniques.
  • Experience with regulated environments (financial services) and working with risk/compliance stakeholders.
  • Contributions to internal standards, reusable libraries, open source, research, patents, or speaking at conferences.

Business: CTO Platforms (AI Platforms)

Job ID: 56078

Location: Guangzhou / Xi'an

Principal Responsibilities

  • Senior technical IC leadership for knowledge intelligence: Act as a hands-on senior technical expert in knowledge intelligence and knowledge management, shaping architecture, technical direction, and implementation approach for an enterprise-grade knowledge platform.
  • Knowledge platform architecture & delivery ownership: Lead the design and build of scalable platform capabilities across ingestion, extraction, enrichment, classification, knowledge asset management, discovery, reuse, governance, and controlled downstream consumption.
  • Industry best practice adoption & engineering standards: Evaluate knowledge management, knowledge engineering, ontology/taxonomy, graph, and AI-assisted curation practices, and translate them into engineering standards, reusable patterns, reference architectures, APIs/SDKs, and runbooks.
  • Knowledge refinement & intelligence workflows: Lead workflows that extract, refine, summarize, classify, deduplicate, consolidate, and contextualize fragmented information into trusted, structured, traceable, and business-aligned knowledge assets.
  • Knowledge graph & semantic layer leadership: Architect and evolve ontology/taxonomy management, entity/relation extraction, entity resolution, graph modeling, graph traversal, lineage-aware context assembly, and graph-based reasoning support for AI and search scenarios.
  • Knowledge lifecycle, governance & self-checking: Establish mechanisms for ownership, validation, versioning, publishing, freshness monitoring, deprecation, retention, rollback, quality scoring, duplication/contradiction detection, and citation/provenance validation.
  • Optimisation & operational readiness: Define SLOs/SLAs, observability, alerting, capacity planning, cost controls, incident response, troubleshooting playbooks, resilience patterns, and continuous production improvement for knowledge platform services.
  • Cross-team influence & enablement: Partner with AI engineering, data platforms, cybersecurity, architecture, product, and domain SMEs to drive adoption, mentor engineers, review designs, unblock complex issues, and communicate trade-offs to senior stakeholders.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Management, Data Engineering, AI, or a related technical discipline; 7+ years of hands-on engineering experience in backend, data, AI, knowledge, search, or enterprise information platforms.
  • Proven experience as a senior technical IC or platform technical lead, owning architecture, engineering standards, design review, implementation quality, optimisation, and production readiness for complex platform capabilities.
  • Deep knowledge of knowledge intelligence and management practices, including taxonomy/ontology design, metadata standards, knowledge refinement, lifecycle management, governance, lineage, and enterprise content operations.
  • Hands-on experience with knowledge graph, semantic search, RAG, agentic AI, or data enrichment systems, plus strong engineering foundations in distributed systems, APIs, data pipelines, observability, CI/CD, Docker, and Kubernetes.
  • Strong security, compliance, production, and stakeholder mindset, with the ability to adopt industry best practices, mentor engineers, influence cross-functional teams, and apply AI-native approaches to improve quality, productivity, and decision-making.

The China Trade and Working Capital Product Head is a senior management level position responsible for managing a broad range of Product Management employees, setting strategy and providing direction, leadership and budgetary management, etc. Additionally, this role will be responsible for the development of product plans, strategies, and tactics while coordinating product lines through product life-cycles in coordination with the broader Product Management team. The overall objective of this role is to coordinate the promotion of products to develop new markets, increase share of market and obtain competitive position.

Responsibilities:

  • Manage a team of professional to accomplish established goals and conduct personnel duties for team (e.g. performance evaluations, hiring and disciplinary actions) as well as negotiate and make decisions on issues/activities having critical impact/influence on company revenues, capital, or business operations
  • Lead strategic product roadmaps, product development, program launches, and program marketing to gain maximum benefit from each product, as well as survey and analyze competitive industry landscapes to identify relative trends, threats, and opportunities for product managers
  • Manage day-to-day product marketing for core products such as product delivery, client experience, and client communication strategies as well as help the team prioritize, negotiate, and remove obstacles to achieve business results
  • Drive client valued propositions, positioning, segmentation, pricing, targeting, channel strategies, and competitive differentiation to achieve preferred status as a partner to Citi clients
  • Develop plans and execute functional strategies for a country, group of countries, region, or business requiring coordination and integration across units as well as provide input into strategic decisions affecting job family or function within region or business
  • Manage client and competitor market research, develop product innovation roadmap, and address fundamental trials of product commoditization to create an advanced set of solutions
  • Oversee all aspects of program life cycle management including market demands, technology trends, and the competitive field as well as drive innovation by working with external partners/alliances to develop products, manage ongoing relationships, and prepare agreements
  • Manage acquisition targets, product financial performance, revenue performance, and expense management goals as well as oversee identification and execution of opportunities and gaps business plans
  • Define and launch new products, features, and capabilities including defining the product/feature and go-to-market strategy, and participate in technology development and market launch activities
  • Develop and communicate a business plan to approach the marketplace, and coordinate and implement team procedures, client problem resolutions and client management
  • Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating particular consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing and reporting control issues with transparency, as well as effectively supervise the activity of others and create accountability with those who fail to maintain these standards.

Qualifications:

  • 15+ years of relevant experience
  • 8-10+ years of managerial experience
  • Experience managing in a global and matrixed environment including managing cross functional areas with direct and indirect reports (e.g. risk, finance, decision management, marketing, operations)
  • Working knowledge of the different systems, theories, and practices relevant to a function as well as practical experience of multiple business cycles
  • In-depth knowledge of industry and competitor products/services

Education:

  • Bachelor’s degree/University degree or equivalent experience
  • Master’s degree preferred

Job Summary

As a Relationship Manager, you will build trusted relationships with Priority Banking and Priority Private Banking clients, helping them achieve their wealth goals through tailored investment and portfolio solutions. Supported by specialists in investment, insurance, products, and treasury, you’ll deliver comprehensive strategies that drive long-term growth and stability.

This role gives you the opportunity to demonstrate your expertise in relationship management, sales, and client engagement, while advancing your career across Wealth and Retail Banking or other client segments.

About Our Wealth And Retail Banking Business

Wealth and Retail Banking (WRB) serves more than 13 million individuals and small businesses, with a focus on the affluent segment including Private Banking, Priority Private, Priority Banking, and Premium. In the mass retail space, we're focused on emerging affluent clients who will progress in their wealth journey with us and form the pipeline of future affluent clients.

We’re a leading wealth manager in Asia, Africa and the Middle East. Our local presence and international network enable us to capture the strong structural tailwinds which are driving cross-border wealth flows. Our comprehensive product offerings span across deposits, payments, financing, advisory, investments and bancassurance.

We’re investing USD $1.5 billion in our Affluent banking business. Our investment focuses on affluent frontline teams, wealth and digital platforms, and client centres, as well as brand and marketing, to drive growth. You’ll join a growing franchise within the Standard Chartered Group.

Key Responsibilities

  • Support our clients in achieving their financial goals as they progress through their career and life-stages.
  • Build long-term relationships by understanding clients’ financial needs and aspirations and delivering tailored wealth and investment solutions.
  • Share timely market insights and investment updates from the Chief Investment Office (CIO) to help clients make informed decisions.
  • Leverage digital tools such as myWealth to create customised portfolios and monitor performance based on CIO guidance.
  • Deliver exceptional client experiences through proactive engagement and personalised service.

Skills And Experience

  • Relevant experience with a minimum of two years in client acquisition, relationship management, and retail banking.
  • Technical expertise in consumer banking products, including treasury, equities, funds, and insurance.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to build and maintain effective client relationships.
  • Proactive and collaborative mindset with the ability to work effectively in a team-oriented, international environment.
  • Local market knowledge with established client networks and understanding of regional dynamics.

About Standard Chartered

We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. We question the status quo, love a challenge and enjoy finding new opportunities to grow and do better than before. If you're looking for a career with purpose and you want to work for a bank making a difference, we want to hear from you. You can count on us to celebrate your unique talents and we can't wait to see the talents you can bring us.

Our purpose, to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity, together with our brand promise, to be here for good are achieved by how we each live our valued behaviours. When you work with us, you'll see how we value difference and advocate inclusion.

Together We

  • Do the right thing and are assertive, challenge one another, and live with integrity, while putting the client at the heart of what we do
  • Never settle, continuously striving to improve and innovate, keeping things simple and learning from doing well, and not so well
  • Are better together, we can be ourselves, be inclusive, see more good in others, and work collectively to build for the long term

What We Offer

In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.

  • Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
  • Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
  • Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
  • Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global Employee Assistance Programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and all sorts of self-help toolkits
  • A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual and digital learning.
  • Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions and geographies - everyone feels respected and can realise their full potential.

ln:4470688536.descriptionHtml:
Some careers have more impact than others.

If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.

HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Manager Open Banking.

Principal responsibilities

Third-Party Service Providers (TSPs) Onboarding

  • Lead end-to-end onboarding for Open Banking TSPs, including registration data capture, and coordinate technical and business readiness through to a safe, controlled go-live.
  • Coordinate screening, due diligence and risk reviews across stakeholders (e.g., Third Party Qualification, RPM, Cyber/TPSR), including risk evaluation scoring, ensuring outcomes, actions and approvals are completed and audit-ready.
  • Drive operational and technical enablement by coordinating terms & conditions/bilateral agreements and completing onboarding prerequisites (e.g., certificate set-up and required tool updates) to enable connectivity.
  • Manage ongoing TSP lifecycle governance and partner support, including periodic due diligence, renewals and exits/service closure, acting as the day-to-day point of contact for TSP and business queries.

Support Business Operations

  • Improve the onboarding experience by optimising the end-to-end digital onboarding journey, maintaining onboarding content (FAQs, web content, guidelines), and reducing drop-offs.
  • Use data to drive action by translating dashboards and reports into insights that inform prioritisation, support campaign targeting, and coordinate execution across commercialisation, marketing and servicing to grow adoption and usage.
  • Maintain platform operations and stability by supporting service activities including developer portal updates, MI/performance reporting, incident/problem coordination, BCM readiness and change management.

Requirements

  • Understanding of Open Banking.
  • Third-party supplier / vendor management.
  • TSP screening and due diligence including Third Party Qualification checks, review of relevant risk per RPM and engagement of Cybersecurity for TPSR review.
  • Risk Evaluation.
  • MI & analytics.
  • Strong stakeholder management.
  • Strong communication skills.

Candidate with less relevant experience or skills may be offered a lower Global Career Band than stated above.

Due to the urgent hiring need, candidates with immediate right to work locally and no relocation need will be prioritised.

You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.

HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

DBS Tech China is hiring a deeply technical, hands-on engineering leader to drive key wealth management initiatives and investment journeys. This role is suited to a strong full stack engineer who can own a stream end to end, lead one or more engineering squads, and stay close to architecture, design, and implementation.

What You’ll Do

  • Lead end-to-end architecture and solution design for Avaloq Banking Suite, translating business requirements into scalable and robust banking solutions.
  • Act as the technical lead for one or more Avaloq delivery squads, driving engineering excellence, platform stability, and solution quality.
  • Design and implement scalable solutions using Avaloq scripting, PL/SQL, Avaloq object modeling, workflow configurations, and extension frameworks.
  • Partner closely with product owners, business stakeholders, architects, and operations teams to translate business requirements into robust Avaloq solutions.
  • Ensure alignment with enterprise architecture principles, security standards, risk controls, and regulatory requirements.
  • Oversee integration design across Avaloq and surrounding banking platforms through APIs, middleware, messaging systems, market data providers, and third-party applications.
  • Contribute directly to complex incident resolution, production stability improvements, and platform optimization initiatives.
  • Perform parameterization and customization in Avaloq Core Banking Platform
  • Analyse business requirements and design / propose software solutions
  • Design, build and maintain efficient, reusable and reliable code to ensure best possible performance and quality
  • Provide technical expertise and support for internal and external stakeholders
  • Mentor and coach team members
  • Assist project / programme managers in project planning & project strategies

What We’re Looking For

  • 5+ years of hands-on Avaloq Core Banking Platform development experience with successful delivery of multiple Avaloq implementation, enhancement, or transformation programmes.
  • Deep expertise in Avaloq Core Banking Platform, including architecture, functional modules, customization, parametrization, scripting, object modelling, workflows, and configuration frameworks.
  • Strong SQL and PL/SQL skills, with proven experience designing and optimizing database solutions within Avaloq environments.
  • Proven track record leading Avaloq solution design and technical delivery across multiple product domains, workstreams, or programmes.
  • Experience leading engineering teams or technology domains within banking, wealth management, or private banking environments.
  • Strong understanding of private banking products, wealth management processes, and core banking operations.
  • Excellent stakeholder management skills, with the ability to engage effectively with business, operations, technology, architecture, vendors, and senior leadership.
  • Ability to balance strategic architectural decision-making with hands-on technical leadership and delivery execution.
  • Strong communication, mentoring, and coaching skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts to both technical and business audiences.
  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline

Guangzhou (DTC)

Job:

Regular

We want to hear from you if…

You are in your penultimate year of a Bachelor's or Master's degree in any discipline from a top academic institution (graduating between Dec 2027 - June 2028)

Who We Think Will Be a Great Fit...

A dedication to learning and a true passion for the business are vital. As industries all over the globe continue to restructure and grow, we are hiring professionals who have a global perspective on the future of banking, and want to make an impact on the corporate level. We value diversity and so do you. We'll also be looking for the following:

  • Commitment to personal growth and career development, a strong desire to learn, and success in team environments
  • Strong communication, planning, and organizational skills
  • Desire to develop a deep understanding of the financial industry
  • Unquestioned commitment to integrity and ethical decision-making


We provide you with the knowledge and skills you need to succeed.

We’re committed to teaching you the ropes. The Summer Analyst Program runs for 10 weeks and begins with initial classroom based training, followed by ongoing training sessions throughout the length of the program, as well as a series of networking and social events. Analysts will complete two rotations across different teams within the Corporate Banking group. Incoming Summer Analysts have the opportunity to be considered for a position on the following year’s full-time Analyst Program.

Your time here will look something like this...

  • Provide advice: this involves working with our clients to develop and execute their strategic objectives. We advise them on a number of areas including whether to buy or sell companies or assets, how to restructure finances, and where and how to invest capital
  • Work with Capital Markets: we work very closely with the Citi CMO team (Capital Markets Origination) to help our clients raise capital in the equity and debt capital markets


You're the brains behind our work.

You’re ready to bring your knowledge from the classroom to the boardroom, and Citi wants to help you get there. Whether it’s honing your skills or building your network, we know that success can’t come without growth. Our programs equip you with the knowledge and training you need to play a valuable role on your team, and establish a long-term career here. At Citi, we value internal mobility, and career growth is not a question of if, but when. Citi is looking for Summer Interns to join the Corporate Banking team in Asia Pacific. Citi’s Corporate Bank is a leading provider of financial services to top-tier multi-national clients around the globe, serving the financial needs of the world's preeminent corporations and financial institutions. The Corporate group advises corporate clients who want to raise funds in capital markets and who need strategic support in financial transactions. Initiatives you may be working on with clients include mergers, acquisitions, divestitures, financial restructurings, underwriting, and distributing equity, debt, and derivative securities. As a Summer Analyst, you will join an intensive ten-week program where you will receive in-depth education on a variety of these topics to learn the fundamentals of the Analyst role and introduce you to Citi’s culture.

We encourage early applications as we recruit on a rolling basis. Each applicant can apply to maximum of 3 summer internship programs in APAC region.

Key Responsibilities

Do you thrive on intellectual challenges and take pride in building robust, well-designed quantitative solutions? Are you interested in applying advanced quantitative methods to complex financial products for a firm with a truly global footprint? We're looking for an outstanding Quantitative Analyst who can:

Research, develop and enhance the valuation and risk management models and tools supporting Cross Asset Financing businesses, including Structured Financing and Fund Financing. 

Apply quantitative techniques to model complex fund structures in bespoke Fund Financing facilities. 

Apply advanced statistical techniques to develop prepayment and default models for securitized products.

Partner with other Quantitative Analytics (QA) teams to develop automated and scalable cross-asset solutions used by Trading, Structuring, and Sales.

Collaborate closely with Trading, Structuring, Risk, and Control functions to perform statistical analysis, develop valuation and risk methodologies, and support business decision-making.

The team

The Credit Quantitative Analytics (QA) team is the Front Office group responsible for developing quantitative models, methodologies, and technology that support pricing and risk management for Credit businesses across the firm, including Credit Solutions, Flow Credit, Cross Asset Financing, Global Banking. The team’s models and infrastructure are used for quoting clients, risk managing trading positions, marking the firm’s books and records. The team works closely with Trading, Structuring, IT and control functions, as well as other QA teams such as Equities, FX, Rates and the central infrastructure team.

Your Skills And Experience

Strong academic background, preferably at the Master’s or PhD level, in a quantitative discipline such as Mathematics, Physics, Computational Finance, Engineering, or a related field.

Proficiency in one of the object-oriented programming languages such as C , C#, Java or Python, with the ability to develop robust and scalable quantitative solutions.

A solid foundation in quantitative finance and derivatives pricing, with knowledge of modern numerical and/or machine learning techniques.

Knowledge of securitized products, fixed income analytics, and complex fund structures is a plus. 

Ability to apply AI and emerging technologies responsibly to improve business outcomes and operational efficiency.

Ability to communicate complex ideas in a fluent and articulate manner.

UBS is a leading and truly global wealth manager and the leading universal bank in Switzerland. We also provide diversified asset management solutions and focused investment banking capabilities. Headquartered in Zurich, Switzerland, UBS is present in more than 50 markets around the globe.

We know that great work is never done alone. That’s why we place collaboration at the heart of everything we do. Because together, we’re more than ourselves. Want to find out more? Visit ubs.com/careers.

We’re dedicated to our craft and passionate about putting our people first, with new challenges, a supportive team, opportunities to grow and flexible working options when possible. Our inclusive culture brings out the best in our employees, wherever they are on their career journey. And we use artificial intelligence (AI) to work smarter and more efficiently. We also recognize that great work is never done alone. That’s why collaboration is at the heart of everything we do. Because together, we’re more than ourselves.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Sr. Associate Director, Delivery Management.

Business: IWPB Technology

Principal Responsibilities

Product strategy and roadmap

  • Define the product vision, strategy and roadmap for technology capabilities related to financial market.
  • Translate investment, operations, client and regulatory requirements into prioritised product outcomes.

Discovery and requirements

  • Experience working with engineering, data, architecture, security and control functions.
  • Excellent stakeholder-management, communication and influencing skills.

  • Experience working in a regulated environment with strong risk and control expectations.

  • Deliver a clear and outcome-focused product roadmap.
  • Improve user experience, process efficiency and data quality.
  • Reduce manual work, operational risk and avoidable rework.
  • Deliver products safely, reliably and within agreed commitments.
  • Increase adoption and user satisfaction.
  • Strengthen controls, auditability and regulatory readiness.
  • Improve transparency across product performance, risks, dependencies and investment.

  • Financial market business and investment teams.
  • Portfolio managers, bankers, traders and research colleagues.
  • Operations, fund administration and client-service teams.
  • Engineering, architecture, data and infrastructure teams.
  • Risk, Compliance, Legal and Information Security.
  • Finance, Procurement and third-party technology providers.
  • Regional and global product and transformation teams.

Personal attributes

  • Customer- and user-focused.
  • Pragmatic, structured and delivery-oriented.
  • Comfortable making decisions in ambiguity.
  • Collaborative and inclusive, with the confidence to challenge constructively.
  • Accountable for outcomes rather than simply outputs.
  • Curious about technology and its practical application.
  • Calm and effective when managing competing priorities.
  • Clear, concise and credible with both technical and senior business audiences.

Job Description

INVESTMENT BANKING

Investment Banking works on some of the most complex financial challenges and transactions in the market today. Whether advising on a merger, providing financial solutions for an acquisition, or structuring an initial public offering, we handle projects that help clients at major milestones. We work with corporations, pension funds, financial sponsors, and governments and are team of strong analytical thinkers, who have a passion for producing out-of-the-box ideas.

The China Advisory team are committed to providing the world-class services to our clients from China. Our bankers play an important role in building relationships and executing transactions. The team, based out of Beijing and Hong Kong, encompasses a wide range of industry coverage, including Consumer Retail, Healthcare, Industrials, Natural Resources, Real Estate, and Technology, Media and Telecommunications (TMT).

YOUR IMPACT

Are you passionate about the financial services industry? We’re looking for an Analyst to join our China Advisory team based in Beijing who wants to be a part of our Investment Banking business and use their skills and ideas to make an impact to the success of the business at Goldman Sachs, focused on the Technology, Media and Telecommunications (TMT) business.

Responsibilities

Our Analysts and Associates play an important role in developing and strengthening our client relationships, participating on our advisory teams and in structuring and executing a full range of financial transactions. Their responsibilities include creating and analyzing financial models, organizing and preparing client presentations, helping manage transaction processes, and assisting in structuring transactions. They will gain exposure to the firm’s businesses and expand their knowledge of the investment banking industry, as they develop key analytical, communications and marketing skills.

Analysts and Associates develop financial models, perform customized company valuation analysis, and are actively involved in mergers and acquisitions (M&A) transactions and fixed income and equity issuances. They organize and prepare presentations, which explain industry trends, assess clients’ situations to provide the necessary financial advice, and recommend strategies to meet client goals. Additionally, Associates coordinate teams of tax advisors, attorneys, and bankers for various transactions; lead due diligence processes and actively participate in the negotiations of legal documentation. From maintaining client communication to helping Goldman Sachs structure client transactions, our Associates are a vital part of Goldman Sachs’ banking team’s investments.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree
  • 1-3 years of prior work experience
  • Highly organized with exceptional attention to detail and follow-through
  • Strong ability to manage multiple projects with competing deadlines
  • Team player with positive attitude and strong work ethic
  • Strong communication skills (written and verbal) in Mandarin and English
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment
  • Ability to adapt quickly to a variety of industries and businesses
  • Ability to self-direct, analyze and evaluate and form independent judgments
  • Ability to effectively interact and build relationships with senior management and global stakeholders
  • Commercially savvy with ability to exercise discretion with respect to highly confidential/sensitive information
  • Integrity, ethical standards and sound judgment

About Goldman Sachs

At Goldman Sachs, we commit our people, capital and ideas to help our clients, shareholders and the communities we serve to grow. Founded in 1869, we are a leading global investment banking, securities and investment management firm. Headquartered in New York, we maintain offices around the world.

We believe who you are makes you better at what you do. We're committed to fostering and advancing diversity and inclusion in our own workplace and beyond by ensuring every individual within our firm has a number of opportunities to grow professionally and personally, from our training and development opportunities and firmwide networks to benefits, wellness and personal finance offerings and mindfulness programs. Learn more about our culture, benefits, and people at GS.com/careers.

We’re committed to finding reasonable accommodations for candidates with special needs or disabilities during our recruiting process. Learn more: https://www.goldmansachs.com/careers/footer/disability-statement.html

The Goldman Sachs Group, Inc., 2026. All rights reserved.

Goldman Sachs is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, veterans status, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

The Banker is a senior level position responsible for assisting clients in raising funds in the capital markets, as well as in providing strategic advisory services for mergers, acquisitions and other types of financial transactions in coordination with the Institutional Banking team. The VP Banker also serves as an intermediary in trading for clients. The overall objective of this role is to act as a strategic advisor to our clients by formulating investment strategies and raising capital for clients.

Responsibilities

  • Assume significant levels of responsibility for the various phases of project and transaction execution, new business development and overall growth of the firm
  • Work closely with clients on financing transactions and guide them through the capital raising process, including leading due diligence and drafting sessions and preparing them for an equity or debt offering
  • Work with clients, senior-level team members and outside professional advisors on M&A and special situation transactions
  • Responsible for drafting situation analyses, pitch materials, information memoranda, investor and management presentations and oversee work being performed by analysts & associates assigned to projects


Recommended Qualifications

  • 6-10 years of experience
  • Experience in the Financial Services industry, specifically within Banking
  • Degree in Finance or closely related areas of Business Administration
  • MBA or Master's Degree in Business preferred
  • Comprehensive knowledge of the corporate banking business and its related products, pertinent regulations and lending and credit approval processes
  • Consistently demonstrates clear and concise written and verbal communication skills
  • Experience with large corporate clients, capital markets products, derivatives, credit, cash management, trade, finance and securities products
  • Series 7 and 63 preferred


Education

  • Bachelor’s degree/University degree or equivalent experience
  • Master’s degree preferred


This job description provides a high-level review of the types of work performed. Other job-related duties may be assigned as required.

  • Engage in defining and optimizing investment banking quality control standard and framework, including policies and procedures, deal process and system
  • Review and assess investment banking transactions with respect to business selection and internal review standards and requirements
  • Perform QC review of the materials and documents submitted/filed/disclosed by deal teams to make sure the compliance with relevant rules and regulations, CSRC / stock exchange requirements and self-regulatory body rules
  • Monitor and assess whether the deal team have diligently performed due diligence duties
  • Perform necessary onsite inspection and issue explicit onsite inspection opinion when material risks are identified
  • Manage and supervise post-issuance continuous supervision and bond entrustment management responsibilities
  • Guide and review the deal teams to complete working paper archiving in accordance with relevant requirements
  • Carry out policy and regulation research and provide advice on transaction execution
  • Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating particular consideration for firm’s reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct and business practice, and escalating, managing and reporting control issues with transparency
  • Familiarity with CSRC/Exchanges/SAC rules
  • Secure and maintain all necessary CSRC licenses (or any other licenses / qualifications as required) for carrying out securities and other regulated activities
  • Preference for HK SFC Type 6 licenses / qualifications
  • Solid accounting, legal and financial knowledge, familiar with A-share investment banking transaction process

The Global Client Executive is a pivotal, senior-level role responsible for managing and growing our most important top-tier corporate client relationships. You will serve as the primary interface for a dedicated client portfolio, acting as their advocate within Citi and a trusted strategic advisor. Your mission is to drive revenue growth and retention by ensuring an unparalleled client experience, fostering deep partnerships with key decision-makers, and strategically aligning Citi’s products and services with their business objectives.

Detailed Responsibilities:

Client Relationship Management: Cultivate and maintain strong, long-lasting partnerships with key client executives and decision-makers, establishing yourself as a trusted advisor for their treasury and financial needs.

Strategic Revenue Growth: Take commercial ownership of your client portfolio. Identify and pursue opportunities for strategic growth, including cross-selling and up-selling of Treasury and Trade Solutions, to meet and exceed revenue targets.

Data-Driven Strategic Insight: Leverage client feedback, performance data, and market trend analysis to provide strategic insights that enhance client satisfaction, inform investment decisions, and foster measurable business growth.

Executive-Level Client Advocacy: Champion client needs within the organization. Collaborate seamlessly with internal partners across Sales, Product, Operations, and Service to resolve complex issues promptly and ensure superior client outcomes.

Strategic Account Planning: Lead proactive relationship reviews with key clients to understand their strategic objectives. Develop and execute comprehensive account plans that drive product adoption, ensure revenue realization, and align with the client’s long-term goals.

Proactive Stakeholder Communication: Ensure internal stakeholders are proactively informed of client needs, product requirements, and strategic priorities to foster alignment and drive execution.

Development Value:

This role offers significant strategic development opportunities, including:

In-depth Strategic Understanding: Cultivate a profound understanding of customer Treasury organizations, specific industries, treasury functions, and the Treasury and Trade Services (TTS) business, its products, risks, and controls, enhancing strategic insight.

Expanded Global Network & Strategic Relationships: Grow your Citi network across the globe, establishing key strategic relationships that drive business outcomes.

Accelerated Career Advancement: Expand and strengthen strategic knowledge, paving the way for advanced opportunities within Sales, Product, or Risk leadership

Qualifications:

A university degree or Equivalent experience.

5+ years of work experience in a senior client-facing role within corporate banking, relationship management, or sales, with a proven track record of leading high-impact strategic projects.

Strategic Thinking: Ability to develop forward-looking plans that deliver sustainable growth and a competitive advantage.

Leadership: Proven experience in motivating and guiding cross-functional teams to achieve ambitious strategic goals.

Business Acumen: A deep understanding of global business, financial drivers, and the treasury solutions landscape.

Communication & Influence: Exceptional verbal and written skills with the ability to influence, negotiate, and strategically engage diverse internal and external stakeholders at a senior level.

Problem-Solving: A strong analytical mindset with the ability to identify complex challenges and design innovative, strategic solutions.

A proven track record of autonomous strategic leadership, ownership, and independent execution of complex tasks.

Citi values diversity. We appreciate a diverse workforce and recognize that differences in style and perspective add strategic value to decisions, actions, and organizational success.

  • Excellent oral and written communication skills.

  • Ability to handle multiple projects simultaneously.
  • Prepare architectural solutions documents and technical audits for the project.
  • Prepare high/low-level technical design documents.
  • Learn and understand relevant application functional and technical architecture for effective development.
  • Follow documented SDLC life cycle as per quality management standards.
  • Participate in requirement gathering and solution meetings.
  • Track overall development and project management.

  • Design modules based on technical specifications.
  • Implement best practices.

If you're looking for a career with purpose and you want to work for a bank making a difference, we want to hear from you. You can count on us to celebrate your unique talents and we can't wait to see the talents you can bring us.

  • Never settle, continuously striving to improve and innovate, keeping things simple and learning from doing well, and not so well

Job Summary

This role exists to ensure the accurate, timely and controlled execution of cash management activities across payment processing, clearing, client instructions, account maintenance and static data services. The role is responsible for delivering reliable operational outcomes that support client transactions, safeguard financial assets and maintain the integrity of the Bank's cash management services.

The role is accountable for processing and validating transactions, maintaining critical customer and product data, identifying and escalating operational exceptions, and ensuring service delivery aligns with agreed service levels, regulatory obligations and internal control standards. Through disciplined execution and strong operational risk management, the role contributes to client satisfaction, operational resilience and sustainable business growth.

Working closely with Operations teams, Service Delivery partners, Risk and Compliance functions, Technology teams and business stakeholders, the role helps convert operational requirements into consistent service outcomes. The role supports process efficiency, client experience and operational excellence but does not own product strategy, client relationship management or enterprise-wide operational policy.

Key Responsibilities

Service Delivery & Transaction Processing

  • Execute payment, clearing and cash management activities accurately and within agreed turnaround times to support uninterrupted client servicing.
  • Validate customer instructions, transaction data and processing requirements to ensure operational accuracy and minimise processing risk.
  • Resolve operational exceptions and processing breaks through timely investigation, escalation and corrective action.
  • Deliver service outcomes that consistently meet productivity, quality and client service standards.

Cash Management Operations & Data Integrity

  • Maintain customer, account and product static data to ensure completeness, accuracy and operational readiness across cash management services.
  • Apply established operational controls when performing account maintenance, pricing, billing and related operational activities.
  • Ensure transaction and client records are accurately captured and maintained to support operational, regulatory and audit requirements.
  • Identify data quality issues and drive corrective actions that improve operational effectiveness and minimise service disruptions.

Risk Management & Control Effectiveness

  • Apply operational risk controls that safeguard the Bank against transaction errors, operational losses and control breakdowns.
  • Conduct independent validation activities in accordance with segregation of duties, authority limits and control requirements.
  • Identify, assess and escalate operational risk events, control weaknesses and emerging risks through appropriate governance channels.
  • Support remediation activities that strengthen control effectiveness and reduce recurring operational issues.

Regulatory Compliance & Governance

  • Apply regulatory requirements, internal policies and operational procedures consistently across all cash management activities.
  • Perform AML, sanctions and other financial crime-related checks in line with Bank standards and escalation requirements.
  • Maintain accurate records and evidence that support audit reviews, governance reporting and regulatory inspections.
  • Promote adherence to conduct, compliance and risk standards that protect the Bank and its clients.

Continuous Improvement & Operational Excellence

  • Identify opportunities to simplify processes, improve service quality and enhance operational efficiency across the end-to-end workflow.
  • Contribute to operational change initiatives, testing activities and business continuity readiness to support resilient service delivery.
  • Support the implementation of digitisation, automation and process enhancement initiatives that improve operational outcomes.
  • Share process insights and improvement opportunities to strengthen team effectiveness and service performance.

Stakeholder & Client Service Management

  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders to resolve service issues and ensure effective delivery of cash management services.
  • Communicate operational issues, risks and service impacts clearly to relevant stakeholders to support timely resolution.
  • Build trusted working relationships that facilitate effective issue management and service improvements.
  • Support a client-focused culture by delivering responsive, accurate and professional operational services.

Motivations

  • Motivated by delivering accurate and reliable operational outcomes in a high-volume, time-sensitive environment.
  • Energised by solving operational challenges, improving processes and enhancing service quality.
  • Thrives in environments that value collaboration, accountability, strong controls and continuous improvement.

Skills And Experience

Priority Skills

  • Payment Processing
  • Cash Management
  • Certification and Accreditation
  • Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC)
  • Operations Management
  • Project Management
  • Service Delivery
  • Settlement Management

Other Skills

  • Transaction Management
  • Issue Management
  • Stakeholder Engagement
  • Service Recovery

Qualifications

  • Business English

About Standard Chartered

We're a global bank connecting clients to our differentiated network, offering growth opportunities in the world's most dynamic markets. Our strategy, which combines cross-border capabilities and leading wealth management expertise, helps us deliver our purpose - to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity.

Over our 170-year history, and across a unique geographical footprint connecting Asia, Africa and the Middle East to each other and the world, we've built a bank like no other, with diverse capabilities and partnerships that set us apart.

What We Offer

  • Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions, and geographies.
  • In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.
  • Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
  • Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
  • Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
  • Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global employee assistance programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and self-help toolkits.
  • A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual, and digital learning.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Principal Data Engineer Data Technology.

 Business: CTO Data Technology

Job ID ： 57085

The Role

As Principal Engineer for the Data Technology Platform you will set technical strategy, architecture and engineering standards across core enterprise data capabilities. The platform estate spans Enterprise Data Assets (EDA), Reference Data, Big Data and Movement and Data Decisioning engineering that underpin data democratisation, AI enablement, customer insight and regulatory compliance. You will shape how distributed data platforms are designed, built and run in hybrid cloud environments so they remain enterprise-ready and future-fit. This role combines deep hands-on engineering direction with influence across product and delivery teams in a global matrixed organisation. Success means clear reference engineering standards, consistent platform patterns and measurable improvements in scalability, observability and cost. You will also strengthen the developer experience so teams can discover, adopt and build on shared data services at pace.

Principal Responsibilities

  • Define and evolve reference engineering standards for core data provisioning platforms aligned to Group Data Strategy and Data Future State Architecture
  • Set technical direction across Enterprise Data Assets (EDA) including APIs for standardised data provisioning
  • Establish engineering approaches for Reference Data Services including golden source alignment and hierarchy management
  • Oversee architecture and engineering patterns for big data ingestion, streaming and transformation at scale
  • Shape decisioning infrastructure including real-time feature stores and orchestration
  • Govern peer reviews to improve consistency, reusability and compliance with enterprise standards
  • Champion DevSecOps, CI/CD and infrastructure-as-code across engineering teams
  • Advance observability, performance engineering, cost optimisation and scalability in hybrid cloud environments
  • Guide teams on data pipelines, APIs, metadata-driven controls and automated testing frameworks
  • Represent the domain in cross-platform technology councils and architecture forums

Knowledge & Experience/Qualifications

  • Bring substantial hands-on experience in data platform engineering, architecture or software development in a scaled enterprise environment
  • Build large-scale data pipelines, APIs and event-driven systems using modern frameworks and technologies such as Spring, Kafka and Spark
  • Apply strong architectural knowledge of data mesh, data lakehouse and real-time customer-facing operational and analytics platforms
  • Use cloud platforms including AWS and GCP alongside containerisation and infrastructure-as-code tooling
  • Implement modern development tooling and automation for modelling, observability, resilience and governance patterns
  • Create reusable platform services that accelerate delivery for data consumers and AI and ML initiatives
  • Communicate complex technical decisions clearly to engineering teams and non-technical stakeholders to align outcomes to strategic objectives

/LP/WX

HSBC is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and, opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of VP - CRM.

Principal responsibilities

  • The role is responsible for the management of all customer information and provision of analytical and data science deliverables for customer and banking initiatives and to support AMH activities. The individual is also expected to identify key trends that arise from the insights of customer data and work with other areas in AMH to ensure they are taken account of.
  • The suitable candidate should be a self-driven person and a leader by nature in taking full ownership of the deliverables. One should be technically profound and fully loaded with business acumen and communication skills. One will work hands-on with the Enterprise Data Warehouse and Jupyter environment for data and modeling process, and are required to deliver the results in a logical and ethical way to the stakeholders.
  • Design, formulate, and implement relevant solutions for the identified analytics project and convert analytical findings/solutions that will lead to achieving business goals (revenue growth, anti-attrition, and increasing customer engagement, etc.). During the process, closely collaborate with relevant teams/parties to obtain the supports required for these tasks. Elevate CRM capabilities to tailor make messaging strategies and journeys that best meet GC customer needs and deliver business outcomes.
  • Use company provided software tools to extract, collect, manipulate (e.g. subset and merge) raw data to prepare for further analysis. Then apply the appropriate analytics frameworks, statistic procedures or machine learning algorithms to analyze the data in order to provide actionable analysis findings. Interpret and present quantitative information as well as the findings in proper context so as to help in the investigations and decision making of the business.
  • To design and develop robust, relevant data mining solutions – descriptive or predictive, the incumbent should flexibly and innovatively apply diverse modelling methods including (but not limited to): decision tree, clustering, logistic regression, gradient boosting, neural network, random forest, support vector machine etc. Mobilise and optimize CRM resources to support the development and ongoing monitoring of GC contact strategies based on customers’ needs (right message at the right time through the right channel), ensuring alignment with regulatory requirements and HSBC standards, with the ambition to lead the market.
  • Drive the improvement of cross border communications via feedback to the GC governance team to maximise customer contact for efficiency and effectiveness
  • Manage the timely delivery of output and effectively communicate with all stakeholders.

Requirements

  • Bachelor (minimum with 6+ year experience) or Master degree in relevant quantitative disciplines such as Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Engineering, Operations Research, Physics or a related discipline with a focus on use of analytics and optimization to influence business decisions.
  • Excellent hands-on analytical skills with proven ability to analyse complex data, identify key trends and opportunities, putting forward hypotheses and delivering recommendations.
  • Mature and independent professional to drive analytics workstream with minimal oversight
  • Train non-analyst stakeholders, teams and audiences to better use our digital analytics suite of tools.
  • Able to work independently with guidance from remote teams.
  • Excellent communication skills. Be able to understand the background of the audience and be able to communicate the message in an effective manner.
  • Proven knowledge and experience of SQL, Python and other Database/Data Manipulation tools (eg max-compute, BI).
  • Experience in data visualization tools and techniques – previous experience in Qliksense, Tableau or similar.
  • Good experience and knowledge of one of analytics tools – Python/R/SAS/SPSS/STATA.

Candidate with less relevant experience or skills may be offered a lower Global Carrer Band than stated above.

Who we are looking for

We are looking for an experienced fund accounting and alternative investment servicing professional to lead a group supporting complex client portfolios. This is a mid-level management role requiring strong technical judgement, operational discipline and the ability to coordinate across clients, counterparties and internal service teams. The successful candidate will take ownership of service delivery, controls, issue resolution and people development in a fast-paced environment with multiple deadlines and evolving operating models.

Why this role is important to us

The team you will be joining is part of Alternative Investment Solutions (AIS), a leading provider of fund accounting, fund administration and operational support services to alternative investment managers and institutional investors.

The team acts as a key coordination and control point across the alternative investment servicing lifecycle. The team connects client requirements with operational execution, helps ensure that investment, transaction, cash, valuation and reporting information is complete and accurate, and drives timely resolution of exceptions. The role is important in maintaining service quality, strengthening the control environment and supporting scalable, technology-enabled delivery across private equity, private credit, fund-of-funds and direct investment structures.

What you will be responsible for

  • Lead the day-to-day delivery of the team, set priorities, allocate resources and ensure activities are completed accurately and within agreed deadlines and service standards.
  • Act as a senior point of contact for clients and internal stakeholders. Maintain effective working relationships, manage expectations, communicate status clearly and escalate material risks or delays promptly.
  • Oversee client and investment onboarding activities, including review and coordination of investment attributes, legal and operational documentation, account and system setup, and hand-offs to downstream teams.
  • Provide oversight of cash and transaction-related activities, including capital calls, distributions, paydowns, interest and fee receipts, payment-in-kind events, transfers, adjustments and other investment lifecycle events, as applicable to the supported operating model.
  • Ensure cash reconciliation, cash reporting, transaction booking inputs and related supporting documentation are complete, accurate, timely and subject to appropriate maker-checker controls.
  • Oversee valuation and market value support processes, including collection and review of source documents, follow-up on missing information, reasonableness checks, exception investigation and coordination with valuation or accounting teams.
  • Coordinate document management activities and maintain evidence required to support operational processing, control execution, client reporting and audit requests.
  • Support annual audit and agreed-upon-procedure activities by coordinating document requests, population and sample evidence, issue follow-up and timely responses across process owners.
  • Own the review and resolution of service issues, exceptions, missed deadlines and potential operational incidents. Ensure root causes, impacts, remediation actions and preventive measures are appropriately documented and tracked to closure.
  • Monitor service performance through KPIs, issue logs, exception reporting and control evidence. Provide clear management reporting and identify trends requiring action.
  • Ensure procedures, checklists and controls remain current, consistently applied and aligned with the approved operating model. Promote strong information-security, confidentiality and risk-awareness practices.
  • Partner with technology, product, operations and project teams on new business, migrations, system enhancements and target operating model changes. Translate business scenarios into clear requirements and participate in testing, readiness and implementation activities.
  • Assess operational effectiveness and drive standardisation, automation and process improvements while maintaining appropriate controls and clear accountability across team hand-offs.
  • Lead, coach and develop team members and subordinate managers. Set objectives, provide timely feedback, support training and succession planning, and foster a collaborative, accountable and inclusive team culture.
  • Contribute to capacity planning, staffing proposals, budget inputs and broader business initiatives. Represent the function in governance forums, client discussions and cross-organisational working groups as required.


What we value

  • Strong ownership and accountability, with a client-service mindset and a consistent focus on quality and risk management.
  • Demonstrated knowledge of alternative investment operations and fund accounting, including private equity, private credit, fund-of-funds and direct investment structures.
  • Strong understanding of investment lifecycle events, including onboarding, funding, capital calls, distributions, repayments, valuations, restructurings and exits.
  • Ability to understand complex transaction and investment scenarios, identify control implications and make well-reasoned decisions based on available evidence.
  • Excellent organisation and prioritisation skills, with the ability to manage multiple deliverables, changing priorities and time-sensitive escalations.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving capability, with close attention to detail and the ability to distinguish small but significant differences in documents, data and transaction terms.
  • Clear, confident written and verbal communication, including the ability to explain technical or operational matters to clients, senior management and cross-functional partners.
  • Ability to influence without relying solely on authority, build alignment across teams and drive actions through to completion.
  • People leadership capability, including coaching, delegation, performance management and development of technical and managerial talent.
  • Curiosity and a continuous-improvement mindset, with the confidence to challenge inefficient practices and propose practical, controlled solutions.
  • A professional, collaborative and resilient approach when working under pressure.


Education And Preferred Qualifications

  • University degree in accounting, finance, economics, business, mathematics or a related discipline. A professional accounting or investment qualification, or progress towards one, is an advantage.
  • At least 7 years of relevant experience in fund accounting, fund administration, alternative investment operations or a comparable financial-services environment, including 2 to 3 years of supervisory or management experience.
  • Experience supporting complex alternative investment products and multi-party operating models is strongly preferred.
  • Experience in client service, operational controls, issue management, audit support, process improvement, migrations or system implementation is preferred.
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and strong working knowledge of Microsoft Office applications. Experience with fund accounting, workflow, documentation or data-management platforms is an advantage.
  • Fluent written and spoken English. Ability to work effectively across locations, cultures and time zones.


Role scope and working relationships

The role works closely with client representatives, fund accounting and NAV teams, middle-office and transaction-processing teams, document management, reconciliation, valuation, financial reporting, audit, technology, product and project-management partners. Responsibilities may vary by client, investment type and target operating model; the Officer is expected to understand the applicable scope, maintain clear ownership and ensure that hand-offs are controlled.
